protocol.feature_fix: Three independently learned terms: Northwest x amber indicator; domestic x centered younger-age score(30-age)/10; West Central Asia x golden-or-pale indicator.21 coefficients total, no pair lookups, no per-question effects, no tare interactions.
protocol.rationale: NW amber term separates shade reversals in conflict sets1 and2. Shared domestic age slope separates age reversal in set1 and domestic/foreign shade-age tradeoff in set4. WCA light-shade step separates set3. Each term is necessary within this declared pool; not a claim of global mathematical minimum over arbitrarily engineered functions.
protocol.controls: Same v16 blended loss, partial labels, regularization grid, threshold calibration, selection rule, outer/inner family splits and monotonicity. Compare against selected v16_blended recipe, not v15. Existing baselines unchanged.
protocol.validation: 5 outer family folds x5 seeds, inner3 folds only for regularization/threshold choice. Reproduce cached v16 margins exactly. Compare direction and binary meaningfulness independently, with proxy/direct subsets separated. No recorded-answer lookup.
protocol.selection: Same v16 joint criterion: average direction accuracy and meaningfulness balanced accuracy; tie-break higher minimum, fewer reversals, stronger ridge, larger threshold. No new tuning choices.
protocol.delivery: Use candidate only if held-out direction and balanced meaningfulness meet or exceed v16, at least one improves, sign reversals do not increase, false meaningful calls do not increase, and directly-supported materiality errors do not increase. Otherwise retain current v16 delivery; save candidate/results independently.
protocol.limits: Terms were motivated by known conflict labels, so repeated-family validation is exploratory, not pristine feature-selection-independent validation.11 of15 conflict records lack verbatim text; no user-label changes or claims of subjective contradiction. Mathematical indistinguishability, not mere prediction error, motivated these terms. No questionnaire in this task.

method.lookup_policy: Every outer prediction is context_feature_difference@test_training_coefficients; baseline uses verified cached model-only margins. No recorded-answer retrieval.
method.limits: Known conflict cases motivated features before this run; same repeatedly used evidence/family folds. Four records have verbatim text and11 only structured direction history. No label corrections or new prospective claims.
